run_text_classification_training: run text classification training on dbpedia14, ag_news, imdb, yelp, or mnli datasets using a pretrained transformer model
run_finetune_transformer: run full finetuning of a transformer model for text classification by passing the --finetune flag
run_linear_probe: run a linear probe by training only the classification head with the transformer frozen as default
run_mnli_evaluation: run natural language inference training on the mnli dataset using premise and hypothesis text pairs
run_save_model: run training and save the model state dict to the result folder as a .pth file
